steps.code:
# Parse the note content to extract songs with RELEASED_AT TODO
import re

content = note1['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs_todo = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Extract song title and artists
        # Format: - Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO
        m = re.match(r'- (.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT TODO$', line)
        if m:
            title = m.group(1).strip()
            artists_str = m.group(2).strip()
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
            songs_todo.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'line': line})
print(f"Found {len(songs_todo)} songs with TODO")
for s in songs_todo:
    print(s)
